groupings.title: Start a project
groupings.description: Choose a new project's stack from Observer's approved menu by interviewing the lead, and record it as the repo's first ADR.

groupings.title: Coordination
groupings.description: Run a whole work track as the coordinator — brief lanes with writing-lane-briefs, have them hand back the PR body with writing-pr-bodies, review with pr-review (author before the PR, gate at the merge), hold the one integration slot.

groupings.title: Authoring
groupings.description: Improve a skill by running it blind on real cases: one clean session per case, a separate judge against a stated bar, and the misses drive the edits.

groupings.title: Release
groupings.description: Promote a rung (development → staging → master) or ship a hotfix: rehearse the merge, migrations and build on copies first, so nothing on the upper rung is lost.

groupings.title: Untangle
groupings.description: Untangle a codebase so agents read less per change and break less: one whole-repo pass (untangle-codebase), then one area at a time with a decision log, proof and a lock (untangle-area).
